svg.title: Baseline and Extension
svg.desc: The lower panel follows the Extension sketch: Input, Planner, LLM, Reflection and Output. Folded contours enclose the LLM and two groups of tools. The paper tools are Open Paper, Summarize, Read Paper and Retrieve. A dashed arrow marks optional close reading after summarization. The paper-tool group connects to Chunk and Embedding, which writes a local vector index.
